user_problem: Procedure authors need concrete cases showing which conditional branches are covered or unspecified.
unique_output: Branch-to-test-input matrix with expected path, unreachable/unknown branches and coverage gaps.
required_input: Supplied procedure conditions, actions, boundary values and any precedence rules.
critical_rule: Unknown branch actions stay unspecified; do not invent a default or claim executable verification.
nearest_existing_and_difference: runbook-scenario-table routes supplied observations; this designs synthetic cases to cover procedure branches.
acceptance_scenario: Rule x>=5 goesA and x<5 goesB yields cases4 and5; missing-value behavior remains uncovered when not supplied.
